## FAQ

### What Salesforce applications does Quantum Metric support?

Quantum Metric supports analytics for virtually any application built on Salesforce, including:

- Sales Cloud
- Service Cloud
- Contact Center
- Inventory/Supply Chain Management
- Resource Planning & Scheduling
- And many more

If your team uses Salesforce to power internal workflows, Quantum Metric can help you understand how employees interact with those experiences and where friction slows them down.

### Do I need to be a current Quantum Metric customer?

No. If you are not currently a Quantum Metric customer, we will work with you to onboard your Salesforce application as your first Quantum Metric digital property just like a website or mobile application.

### How do I deploy Quantum Metric across my Salesforce application?

Deploying Quantum Metric on Salesforce is about the same as deploying Quantum Metric across any other website or application. Our team works with you to make sure we’re capturing and configuring all the relevant data so you can get started understanding insights and taking action quickly.

### Salesforce already includes reporting and dashboards. Why do I need Quantum Metric?

Native Salesforce reporting shows what data exists in the system including records created, fields updated, and pipeline stage. Quantum Metric captures how employees actually experience Salesforce, including:

- Where users hesitate or abandon workflows
- Rage clicks and repeated actions
- Slow or inefficient navigation paths
- UI friction and usability issues
- Areas where employees create workarounds

Together, Salesforce reporting and Quantum Metric provide both operational data and behavioral insights, giving teams a complete view of Salesforce performance.

### Does this require custom development or Salesforce API changes to implement?

No. We just need to deploy a QM Aura Component. No other "custom" development needed.

### Will Quantum Metric work with heavily customized Salesforce environments?

Yes. Quantum Metric supports highly customized Salesforce Lightning applications and custom Lightning pages. Our team will review your implementation to ensure the appropriate data can be captured. For example we won't be able to capture iframes out-of-the-box.
